ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Greentide Raid Ant
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
THEY_MOD_REPLICATION_1. Replicates They! (Giant Ants) (Sapiently.TheyAtomicMonsters, workshop id 3620253282) in our own tier and retires the dependency: the race, its two pawn kinds, the hidden permanentEnemy raid faction, the carapace leather and the carapace wall, all re-authored from the donor's own plain-text XML (read directly off disk, not decompiled). The one piece of donor C# — MyAntMod.JobGiver_AntRaid, a directed off-map assault that bypasses the incident/Lord system — is replaced by RM_JobGiver_DirectedAssault + RM_DirectedAssaultExtension in mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors, built from vanilla JobGiver patterns (AttackTargetFinder.BestAttackTarget, the same call JobGiver_AIFightEnemy makes) rather than reading the donor DLL's bytecode.
Greentide raid-events-only per BIOME_FAUNA_ASSIGNMENT_SITTING_1 — this is not a wildlife roster addition.
Owed before They! can actually leave the active mod list (tracked on THEY_MOD_REPLICATION_1, not repeated here): a coined pseudo-Star-Wars label carded per NONCANON_BEAST_RENAME_1's standard (this def currently ships with the donor's own plain-English "giant ant" label as a placeholder — defNames are internal and do not need the card, only what the player reads does); new art for the ant, its dessicated body, and the carapace wall (queued via artpipe, no reference= — new art, not a reskin); two short raid-call sound clips; and a full-list live-verify session with They! disabled.
